newsitem.title: USA: Universal Outdoor to buy Matthew Outdoor.
newsitem.headline: Universal Outdoor to buy Matthew Outdoor.

text.p: Universal Outdoor Holdings Inc said Monday it will acquire the assets of Matthew Outdoor Advertising Acquisition Co, a privately held outdoor advertising company, in a deal valued at $40 million.

The assets include outdoor displays in New York and New Jersey with a total of more than 1,000 display faces, said Universal. The displays are expected to generate commissions of about $9 million for 1996, the company said.
A definitive agreement is expected to be signed next week.
Universal Outdoor operates an estimated 21,100 outdoor advertising displays in 14 Midwest and Southeastern markets.
